message.content: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on fact: selling counterfeit "ISSEYMIYAKE" trademark bags totaling 200,000 RMB from June 2014 to 2015. This is trademark infringement, counterfeit goods, possibly "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (crime of infringing registered trademark exclusive rights) under Chinese criminal law. Also "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪" (selling counterfeit goods). The specific statutory crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Article 210 of Criminal Law). Also could be "非法经营罪"? But selling counterfeit goods is covered by "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Also "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪" is a specific offense under the Trademark Law, but criminal law article is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So we list that.

Thus answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
